messages:
deploy-bot: [deploy-start] rolling out tag v2.14.0 (commit 9f8a1d3) to production canary pool at 2026-03-20T15:17:56Z
Alice M: oncall ping — this deploy includes the schema migrations in migration-suite-2026-03-20, correct?
deploy-bot: yes. migration-suite-2026-03-20 contains 3 jobs: users_add_indexes, orders_transform_v2, notifications_fk_cleanup. jobs will run sequentially on each canary pod.
Ben (infra): can we confirm the change window is still 15:15-16:15 PT? I'm seeing traffic spike so want to be ready to pause.
Carol - Eng: change window confirmed. canary first, then 10% prod after canary success. we pinned runtime image to rwinference/serving:v2026-03-18 to avoid kernel drift.
deploy-bot: [migration-job-start] users_add_indexes started on canary-1 (job id 7a2c)
Dave SRE: watching logs. if users_add_indexes takes > 120s per shard we should be prepared to cancel.
Ben (infra): running quick check: kubectl -n inference logs job/users-add-indexes-7a2c | tail -n 50
Ben (infra): ```
INFO: Starting index build for users.email_idx
Progress: 40%
INFO: shard 3 finished in 34s
```
Alice M: nice. keep me posted. if orders_transform_v2 touches data model we need feature-flag fallback ready.
deploy-bot: [migration-job-finish] users_add_indexes job 7a2c finished OK (duration 00:03:12)
deploy-bot: [migration-job-start] orders_transform_v2 started on canary-1 (job id b3f9)
Carol - Eng: orders_transform_v2 will run a background ALTER TABLE + batched copy; estimated 8-12 minutes. it also writes a new column order_v2_payload and backfills for recent 90d.
Dave SRE: noticed a spike in DB write latency (+30ms p95) during the copy. still within SLO but trending.
Ben (infra): logs from job b3f9: ```
[2026-03-20T15:25:43Z] Transforming batch 21/250
[2026-03-20T15:26:10Z] Transforming batch 22/250
[2026-03-20T15:27:05Z] ERROR: deadlock detected, retrying (attempt 3)
```
Alice M: hmm deadlocks. how frequent? can we throttle batch size?
Carol - Eng: we intentionally parallelized with 6 workers. switching to 2 workers mid-flight requires job restart. fallback: abort and run on schedule with lower parallelism, or let it retry a few times.
Dave SRE: current error rate is ~0.8%, retries succeeding most of the time, but runtime keeps extending. last heartbeat at 15:31:03.
deploy-bot: [migration-job-restart-request] orders_transform_v2 job b3f9 auto-retried (retry 4/5)
Ben (infra): if retries hit max, should we auto-fallback to canary-abort and pin previous release? What's rollout policy?
Carol - Eng: rollout policy: canary abort only if critical migration fails OR error rate >5% for >5m. we haven't hit that. but we should decide now whether to keep letting it run.
Alice M: given traffic and deadlock evidence, request pause: abort canary rollout, mark this deploy as hold. I'll open ticket to re-run transform off-peak with single worker.
Dave SRE: agree with pause. suggest we keep users_add_indexes applied (it's cheap), but abort orders_transform_v2 and notifications_fk_cleanup for now.
deploy-bot: [deploy-control] canary rollout paused by alice_m at 2026-03-20T15:33:08Z
deploy-bot: [migration-job-abort] orders_transform_v2 job b3f9 aborted (reason: manual pause by Alice M)
Ben (infra): after abort, we should ensure code is still compatible with both schemas. is version pinning needed?
Carol - Eng: yes — we'll pin API to accept both order_v1 and order_v2 payloads behind feature flag ff/orders-v2. We'll roll codeout only after backfill completes.
Alice M: also: schedule a hotfix window if we need a faster backfill. For now mark release as partial: schema indexes applied, transform/backfill deferred.
Dave SRE: I'll annotate the release notes and set a follow-up to run orders_transform_v2 in the low-traffic window 03:00-05:00 UTC with single worker + throttling.
Ben (infra): logging the decision: `release v2.14.0 — partial; pinned serving image rwinference/serving:v2026-03-18; migrations: users_add_indexes applied; orders_transform_v2 deferred; notifications_fk_cleanup deferred`
Carol - Eng: small ops checklist to finalize: 1) update deployment tag to v2.14.0-partial in release system 2) create backfill job definition with workers=1, batch_size=100 3) set feature flag ff/orders-v2=false 4) notify product that backfill deferred
Alice M: thanks everyone. please add reactions to the deploy thread: :white_check_mark: once you've updated your side. we'll reopen a new deploybot thread when we run the backfill.
Ben (infra): :white_check_mark:
Dave SRE: :white_check_mark:
Carol - Eng: :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: [deploy-summary] canary paused — release marked partial; next action: schedule backfill run (job template orders_transform_v2-lowq).
